combo1.title: Going First: Black Chaos + Griffoh into Magician of Dark Chaos
combo1.description: Black Chaos places Mind Shuffle face-up from the Deck without using your Normal Summon. Mind Shuffle adds Skull Archfiend of Chaos and discards it, and Skull Archfiend sends Light and Darkness Ritual to the GY and adds Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos. The Ritual's GY effect hands itself and Black Chaos back, Black Chaos becomes the Level 8 Tribute, and the Magician returns the Ritual Spell to your hand. Griffoh then Sets Chaos Magical Hats. End board: Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos, face-up Mind Shuffle and a Set Chaos Magical Hats, all shielded from destruction and banishment by the Magician. Starting hand: Black Chaos + Griffoh.

Place Mind Shuffle face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone from your Deck. Placing a card doesn't add or send it from the Deck, so Ash Blossom has nothing to hit here.

Add Skull Archfiend of Chaos to your hand.
Discard Skull Archfiend of Chaos for Mind Shuffle's discard.
Activate effect: Skull Archfiend of Chaos. It was sent to the GY, so it sends 1 Ritual Spell from your hand or Deck to the GY and adds a Ritual Monster whose name is on that Spell.
Send Light and Darkness Ritual from your Deck to the GY.
Add Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos from your Deck to your hand. The Ritual names both bosses; going first, take the Magician, because it protects your Spells and Traps.
Activate effect: Light and Darkness Ritual in your GY. Once per turn, it adds itself and 1 card that mentions it from your GY to your hand.
Add Light and Darkness Ritual to your hand.
Add Black Chaos back to your hand as the second card. Its discard effect mentions the Ritual.
Activate Light and Darkness Ritual from your hand.
Tribute Black Chaos from your hand. It's Level 8, which covers the Magician's Level on its own. Keep Griffoh in hand for its Quick Effect.
Ritual Summon Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos.
Light and Darkness Ritual goes to the GY once it has resolved.
Activate effect: Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos. It was Special Summoned, so it adds 1 Spell from your GY to your hand.
Add Light and Darkness Ritual back to your hand for your next turn.
Activate effect: Griffoh in your hand. It's a Quick Effect: the cost is discarding Griffoh, and it Sets 1 Quick-Play Spell or Trap that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual from your Deck.
Discard Griffoh to the GY as the cost.
Set Chaos Magical Hats from your Deck. While the Magician is face-up, your opponent's card effects can't destroy or banish it or Mind Shuffle.

combo2.title: Their Turn: The Mind Shuffle Tag-Out
combo2.description: This line starts from the end board of the going-first line: Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos on the field, Mind Shuffle face-up, Chaos Magical Hats Set and Light and Darkness Ritual in your hand. On your opponent's turn, Mind Shuffle's add is available again, so it adds Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness. When your opponent activates a card or effect, Mind Shuffle returns the Magician and brings Black Luster Soldier in, and its Special Summon trigger banishes a card. Mind Shuffle's tag-out has no once-per-turn limit, so a second activation swaps the Magician back in, and its trigger returns the Ritual Spell from the GY.

combo3.title: Going Second: Black Chaos + Ragged Records Banish Three
combo3.description: Ragged Records of Rites reveals Light and Darkness Ritual in the Deck and adds Skull Archfiend of Chaos. Black Chaos places Mind Shuffle, Mind Shuffle adds Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness, and Skull Archfiend is the discard, so it sends the Ritual Spell and adds the Magician. The Ritual's GY effect returns itself and Black Chaos. Tributing the Magician puts a Spellcaster Ritual Monster in the GY, which is the cost for Black Chaos's own summon. Black Luster Soldier banishes 1 card when it's summoned, and Black Chaos banishes 2 without targeting while a Ritual Spell is in your GY. Both summons come from the hand, so Mulcharmy Fuwalos draws nothing. Starting hand: Black Chaos + Ragged Records of Rites.

combo4.title: Beyond the Brave: Black Chaos + Black Skull Dragon Set the Sword
combo4.description: Going first with Black Chaos and Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity (Beyond the Brave, TCG 8 Oct 2026). The usual engine line Ritual Summons Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos, whose summon effect returns Light and Darkness Ritual to your hand. Discarding that Ritual Spell Special Summons the dragon, and the Ritual lands back in the GY for next turn. The dragon's trigger Sets Spell Shattering Sword from the Deck. End board: the Magician, Black Skull Dragon, face-up Mind Shuffle and a Set Spell Shattering Sword, both protected by the Magician. Starting hand: Black Chaos + Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity.

combo5.title: Beyond the Brave, Their Turn: Spell Shattering Sword, Then the Tag-Out
combo5.description: This line starts from the end board of Line 4: Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos and Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity on the field, Mind Shuffle face-up, Spell Shattering Sword Set and Light and Darkness Ritual in the GY. Mind Shuffle adds Black Luster Soldier in your opponent's Standby Phase. When a face-up monster of theirs activates its effect, Spell Shattering Sword shows the Ritual in your GY and negates it, like Infinite Impermanence. On their next activation, Mind Shuffle returns the Level 9 dragon to your hand and brings in Black Luster Soldier, which banishes a card. The Magician stays on the field the whole time, so your backrow stays protected.

combo6.title: Beyond the Brave, Going Second: Griffoh Sets the Sword for the Same Turn
combo6.description: Going second with Black Chaos and Griffoh. The engine line Ritual Summons Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness, which banishes 1 card. Griffoh then Sets Spell Shattering Sword (Beyond the Brave, TCG 8 Oct 2026) from the Deck, and its effect lets you activate the Sword the same turn. The Sword shows Light and Darkness Ritual from the GY to turn your opponent's remaining monster into a 0-ATK monster with no effects. Black Luster Soldier destroys it by battle, gains 1500 ATK and attacks again: up to 7500 damage. Starting hand: Black Chaos + Griffoh.
